dct_description_sm: Related Publication gives detailed account of the system used to generate the DataSet.

Droplets consisting of Dynabeads M-270, C1, T1 Streptavidin (Invitrogen) and 10 mg of VECTB2007 biotinylated bovine serum albumin (BSA) (Vector Laboratories) at 1.6µg/mL in dual-phase microfluidics at varying speeds 60, 90, and 120µL/min flowrate in two different types of tubing i.e. PTFE and Tygon. Non-biotinylated BSA in PBS buffer is used as the negative control. Images are extracted from the videos and cropped around the droplets. Droplets pass through three different viewing windows to show the effects of incubation.
dct_title_s: DataSet for Effect of Flowrate, Tubing, and Incubation for DynaBeads Streptavidin with biotinylated BSA Droplets in Dual Phase Lab-in-Tubing Microfluidics
